messages:
marta: postdeploy quickcheck apac3 — synth-kv-heartbeat p95 jumped ~10s after today's rollout. deploybot shows overall green but synth flagged. anyone seeing prefills/kv errors?

vikram: saw the p95 bump too, noticed tokenizer 503s around the same timestamp. not yet sure if it's routing or model variant.

ben: gateway traces show increased tail at proxy layer, not full 5xx volume. could be warm start noise.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout complete 2026-03-20T18:14Z — revision r2026.6 deployed to apac3. Smoke summary: 23/24 checks passed. synth-kv-heartbeat (apac3) FAILED: p95 +10s vs baseline.

marta: can we pin apac3 to previous revision while ops investigates? want minimal blast radius.

ops_sre: oncall looking. running quickcompare of traces and a targeted warmup. will post results in ~15m.

vikram: quick idea — the new quant variant landed in apac3 only. leaning toward pinning variant rather than full rollback.

ben: i can issue a region pin via deploybot. plan: pin apac3 -> r2026.5 for 30m, re-run synths. if metrics stable, we'll unpin and coordinate a re-eval.

ben: /deploy pin-region apac3 r2026.5 --reason 'synth-kv p95 spike post-roll r2026.6'

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: region pin request received from ben. pinning apac3 -> r2026.5 now. warmup actions kicked off.

ops_sre: warmup logs show prefill traffic ramping. running replay + KV smoke. curl check that reproduces kv latency below:

```bash
curl -X POST https://apac3.smoke.internal/kvcheck -d '{"key":"smoke-123","op":"get"}' -H 'content-type: application/json'
```

ops_sre: after 12m warmup, synth-kv p95 back within baseline (+0.8s). no 503 spikes in tokenizer traces.

marta: great. unpin plan? hold 30m then unpin and monitor. filing note in release notes.

release-ci: added release note: 'apac3 temporarily pinned to r2026.5 during investigation of a post-deploy synthetic kv p95 increase; root cause under investigation (variant/quant). follow-up scheduled.' link: https://release.internal/notes/r2026.6

ben: started 30m hold timer. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: apac3 pin active. will auto-unpin at 1725528956 unless manually extended.

marta: closing thread for now, reopen if flaps. thanks all.
